title: Saudi Strikes on Bani Hashih Reportedly Kill At Least 15; Houthi Media Cites 11 Dead in Sanaa Province
detail: Middle East Eye live-blog reports Saudi attacks on Bani Hashih killed at least 15 people, while Houthi media said 11 were killed in Saudi strikes on Sanaa province. Separately, Yemeni government forces claimed an attack on Houthi positions in al-Misrakh. Casualty figures are from live-blog updates and Houthi media and are unverified.
